turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
You entered a zero on Owen's essay before anyone called me. Why?
So the defense is that he just types really fast?
I haven't said a word about how he types. You decided on a zero before you heard from him or from me; on what basis?
182 words in six minutes. Wow. Maybe he should be a court stenographer.
Save the jokes for your class. 182 words in six minutes, according to what record, dated when? Turn the screen.
I'm not the one with a theory, Hale. Show me the record or withdraw the zero.
